summary: The newsletter popup trapped keyboard focus between Email and Subscribe, with a close control that was a non-focusable span and Escape blocked. The close control is now a real labelled button inside the focus loop, Escape closes the popup, the popup is a labelled modal dialog, and focus returns to where the shopper was when it closes.

accepted.replace: <button type="button" class="x" id="promo-close" aria-label="Close newsletter offer">×</button>
accepted.why: A native button can be reached and activated by keyboard and has an accessible name.
Expose the popup as a named modal dialog to assistive technology.
Escape must close a modal dialog instead of being swallowed.
Include the close button in the dialog's Tab cycle so it can be reached.
